game: Hollowbough (own-name adaptation of the original base game)
notes: Original role keys follow the base game card roles; new_name and new_text are original.
Every number (cost, base_points, copies, type, unique/common, kind) was asserted equal across two independent sources; see sources.md.

timing.on_play: resolves once when the card enters the city
timing.production: also resolves in spring and autumn Prepare for Season (green cards)
timing.ongoing: triggered or continuous while in city
timing.ongoing_discount: card-playing ability, only one per card played

vocabulary.gain_any: choose any of the four resources, not points or cards

ops.per: each unused resin or pebble in your supply

spec.note: Resources sitting on a Storehouse do not count.

cards.new_text: At the end of the game, score 1 point per resin and per pebble you still hold, to a maximum of 6.
Sing away up to 5 cards from your hand and take a point token for each.
Gain 2 twigs for every Allotment (Farm-role card) in your city.

ops.target: any 1 other production card in your own city

spec.note: ASSUMPTION: cannot target itself or another Tinder Chipmunk recursively beyond one level (source silent).

cards.new_text: Re-run one other production card in your own city.
Spend up to 3 berries and take a point token for each one spent.

spec.note: Cannot be played into your own city. Also playable into a city that has passed. Solo: Old Grimbeard may play it into your city; if you play it, discard it and remove 1 Old Grimbeard card instead.

cards.new_text: Plant this prankster in a rival village; it takes one of their spaces and costs them 2 points.

ops.trigger: after you play another Critter or Construction (after the played card resolves)

cards.new_text: Whenever you play another card, draw 1 card afterwards.

ops.condition: paired with a Wife AND you have at least 1 Farm in city

cards.new_text: Shares a space with one Goodwife. If paired and you own an Allotment, gain any 1 resource on play and every production.

ops.swap: 1 resource in cost may be paid with 1 different resource you own

cards.new_text: When playing any card, pay one required resource with a different resource of your choice.
End of game: 1 point per basic event and 2 points per special event you achieved.

ops.source: any 1 green production card in an opponent city

spec.note: Cannot copy a Storehouse. May copy another Echo Mole.

cards.new_text: Mimic any one production card in a rival village, as though it were theirs.
Give up to 2 berries to a rival and take 2 point tokens for each. Opens the second Cloister slot.
Swap up to 2 of your resources for any 2 resources from the supply.

spec.note: The free card triggers Courthouse/Historian-type triggers. Solo: counts as 2 cards played for Old Grimbeard.

cards.new_text: Reveal 2 cards; you may play one worth up to 3 base points free; discard the other.
Send a worker here to play any card worth up to 3 base points from hand or meadow without paying.

ops.rule: to a new location following normal placement rules

spec.note: Cannot be the prisoner in the 2nd cell.

cards.new_text: Relocate one of your deployed workers to another legal spot. Opens the second Thornhold cell.

ops.n: equal to point tokens currently on your Chapel

spec.note: Italic clause printed on card; absent from rulebook index (see disagreements).

cards.new_text: Gain 3 berries plus 1 point token per token on your Shrine. If bought with berries, they go to a rival.

ops.trigger: after you play another Critter into your city

cards.new_text: Gain 1 berry whenever you play another Critter.

spec.note: Hand limit 8 applies (draw only what fits).

cards.new_text: Draw 2 cards, keep one, and hand the other to a rival.

Draw 3 cards. Does not use up a city space.
Shares a space with a Goodman; if paired, worth 3 extra points at the end.
Spend up to 3 twigs and take a point token for each.
End of game: 1 point per common construction in your city.

ops.per: each point token on this card (after adding)

spec.note: Tokens on the card are lost if the card leaves the city; they score at game end.

cards.new_text: Add a point token here, then draw 2 cards for every token now on the Shrine.

ops.target: a basic or forest location where you have a deployed worker

spec.end_game: tokens left on the card score 1 each

Gain 1 twig, resin or pebble each time you build another construction.
When building a Construction, dismantle this lift to cut 3 resources of your choice off the price.

spec.note: Only one cell per played card even with both open.

cards.new_text: Lock one of your Critters beneath this card to cut 3 resources off the price of a card. Opens a second cell with a Trailwarden.

ops.per: Prosperity (purple) card in your city, including this one

spec.occupy: its occupied token can host any one Critter for free

cards.new_text: End of game: 1 point per purple card in your city (itself included). Can house any one Critter for free.
Draw 2 cards.
Gain 1 berry.

ops.condition: you have at least 1 Farm (flat +1, not per Farm)

cards.new_text: Gain 1 berry, or 2 berries if you own any Allotment.
Send a worker to play a meadow card for 3 fewer resources. Rivals may visit too and pay you 1 point.

ops.note: even if one of your own workers is there

cards.new_text: Copy any one basic or forest spot, even if it is occupied.
Gain 1 pebble.

ops.per: Unique Construction in your city, including this one

cards.new_text: End of game: 1 point per unique construction, itself included.

spec.solo: may visit Old Grimbeard Post Office; Old Grimbeard gains 1 point token

cards.new_text: Give a rival 2 cards, discard any others you like, then refill your hand from the deck. Visitors pay you 1 point.

ops.discard: 1 Construction of yours; this card takes its space (works in a full city)

spec.cost_note: Free card; needs a Construction to replace.
spec.worker_note: Workers permanently on a replaced card are lost; a normal worker moves to this card.

cards.new_text: Raze one of your constructions, build here in its place, regain its exact cost, and draw 2 cards.

visit.op: take all resources stored on this card

spec.note: Cannot be copied by Echo Mole; stored resources do not count for Architect.

cards.new_text: Each production adds a stack (3 twigs, 2 resin, 1 pebble or 2 berries) to this card; send a worker to haul it all away.

Gain 2 twigs.

spec.worker_note: If the discarded card held permanent workers, they move here permanently.

cards.new_text: Disband one of your cards, regain its exact cost, plus any 1 resource and 1 point.
